fichas.title: Technical Drawings: Standard Sheet Formats and Folding
fichas.summary: Explains the use of ISO A-series drawing sheets, title-block placement, paper-roll widths, and folding drawings for A4 box-file storage. Standard formats support layout, discussion, posting, and filing; folding instructions keep the title block visible and identify the punched or clamped edge.
uses: Preparing and trimming technical drawing sheets
Laying out drawings for design-office or building-site discussion
Folding drawings for storage in A4 box files
